children: The address known as "Machi Big Brother" currently holds about $146 million in BTC and ETH long positions, with combined unrealized gains of about $2.56 million. According to Odaily, the account's net assets are about $9.139 million, and its overall leverage is about 15.95 times.

Its ETH position is a 25x cross-margin long of 39,325 ETH, worth about $98.39 million, with an average opening price of $2,444.83 and unrealized gains of about $2.25 million. The liquidation price is $2,331.21. Its BTC position is a 40x cross-margin long of 593 BTC, worth about $47.39 million, with an average opening price of $79,384.2 and unrealized gains of about $310,000. The liquidation price is $68,731.5.

title: Machi Big Brother Address Holds $146 Million in BTC and ETH Longs
